g.text: Product.stock used only for legacy orders (marker false).
Public stock = ingredient capacity for S without toppings.
Client size/toppings are validated, prices recomputed on server.
Only SUCCESS results are cached by API key (BR-05); FAILED does not lock the key.
At most one PENDING per Order (BR-10), enforced by a partial unique index.
provider = "VNPAY" for new rows; rows created before VNPay keep "SIMULATOR".
gatewayCreateDate = the exact signed vnp_CreateDate string; QueryDR needs it unchanged.
gatewayResponseCode and gatewayTransactionStatus are stored apart.
"EXPIRED" is an internal gatewayResponseCode value, not a PaymentStatus.
No card number is stored: the card is entered only on the VNPay page.
No REFUNDED value: refund (FR-26) is Won't.
Water / ice unlimited; only tracked lines limit cups.
HTTP amounts are decimal strings; canonical units.
Exactly one selector: productId+size OR topping.
Empty/missing base or no tracked base line is unavailable.
Unique orderId+ingredientId; quantities aggregate ALL cart lines.
New orders marker true: reserve snapshot; payment consumes;
decline keeps; owner cancel releases reserved exactly once.
Recipe edits never modify snapshot; legacy false has no snapshot.
